title: Choose the layout
question: Same field-guide look for all three. Pick how the page is organized.

options.label: Band ladder
options.lineage: the guide's “Behaviour by behaviour” rows, extended to every population
options.thesis: One row per field target: the wild band, and every troop as a dot on it.
options.viewport: A score strip (how many bands each troop hits), then grouped target rows with all troops on each band.
options.risk: Many dots per row; needs a focus toggle to read one troop at a time.

options.label: Findings first
options.lineage: science-journal figures: one finding, one figure
options.thesis: Each section is a plain finding with the one chart that proves it.
options.viewport: Headline finding (“Trained troops barely travel”) over one large chart comparing troops with the wild band.
options.risk: Slower to scan every target; details live below the fold.

options.label: Troop cards
options.lineage: a field-station roster: one card per community type
options.thesis: Each troop gets a card: how many wild bands it hits and where it misses.
options.viewport: Four cards across (rules, untuned, baseline, aggressive, collaborative), each with a big in-band count and a small deviation profile.
options.risk: Comparing one target across troops takes a second look at the table below.
